author: yassinyl
description: Motrix Server is a headless download manager for HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent and magnet links, with a browser-based interface.
tagline: Powerful download manager for your NAS

tips.before_install: Motrix Server runs as UID/GID 1000. On first start, open /DATA/AppData/<AppID>/data and copy operator-token into the Web UI. Direct HTTP operator access is enabled for trusted-LAN use; do not expose port 8080 to the Internet. For remote pairing, configure MOTRIX_PUBLIC_URL with the reachable Web UI URL. MDXP uses port 16801. Ensure the data and downloads folders are writable by UID/GID 1000.

title: Motrix
